dialogues.speaker: Gustave
dialogues.text: ...Is it really alright, Miss Pavlova? For you to spend all this time sightseeing with me like this? Am I taking you away from your work at the troupe?

dialogues.speaker: Pavlova
dialogues.text: Hehe. Please don't worry about it, Mr. Gustave. You may not know it, but I've been out of the limelight for a while now. I don't really take to the stage much due to my age.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlova
dialogues.text: These days, I spend most of my time traveling here and there to scout for young talent... Besides...

dialogues.speaker: Pavlova
dialogues.text: It's only right that I keep you company for a while, since it's because of the troupe that you... It's only because of the slow progress on our co-production that you're stuck here in Snezhnaya instead of being back in Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Gustave
dialogues.text: *Sigh* When will we actually finalize the numbers? And the structure, too...? I've been here for three months now, and we don't seem to be making any progress.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlova
dialogues.text: There may be light at the tunnel soon, you never know. But before that, let me tell you about a spot you definitely should visit...

dialogues.speaker: Gustave
dialogues.text: ...Are you sure this isn't an excuse for you to go gallivanting, Miss Pavlova?
